topicName: Bày tỏ lời cảm ơn và xin lỗi

rules.rule: Cách bày tỏ lời cảm ơn:
rules.formula: Thank you (very much) for + N/V-ing / Thanks a lot / It was very kind/nice of you to + V
rules.examples: Thank you for helping me. / Thanks a lot for the ride. / It was very kind of you to invite us.

rules.rule: Cách đáp lại lời cảm ơn lịch sự:
rules.formula: You're welcome / My pleasure / Not at all / Don't mention it / No problem / Anytime / I'm glad you liked it
rules.examples: - 'Thank you for dinner.' - 'Don't mention it. I'm glad you liked it.' / - 'Thanks!' - 'You're welcome.'

rules.rule: Cách bày tỏ lời xin lỗi:
rules.formula: I'm (so/terribly) sorry for + N/V-ing / I apologize for + N/V-ing / Please forgive me
rules.examples: I'm sorry for being late. / I apologize for stepping on your foot.

rules.rule: Cách đáp lại lời xin lỗi (tha thứ, thông cảm):
rules.formula: That's all right / That's OK / Never mind / Don't worry about it / It doesn't matter / Forget it
rules.examples: - 'Sorry, I broke the cup.' - 'Never mind. It was an accident.' / - 'I'm sorry.' - 'That's OK.'

rules.rule: Lưu ý tránh bẫy đề thi:
rules.formula: KHÔNG NHẦM LẪN CẢM ƠN VÀ XIN LỖI
rules.examples: Tuyệt đối KHÔNG dùng 'You're welcome' để đáp lại lời xin lỗi. KHÔNG dùng 'Never mind' để đáp lại lời cảm ơn.
